crossRefs.note: Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.
He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and…
“Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
All the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have…
He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.
He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little…
The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you…
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to…

translations.web: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
translations.bsb: He sets the lowly on high, so that mourners are lifted to safety.
translations.kjv: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
translations.asv: So that he setteth up on high those that are low, And those that mourn are exalted to safety.
